descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum ‘Pink Princess' Dwarf Pink Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 ‘Pink Princess’ is a new dwarf compact selection of Japanese maple with a variegated leaf. There are very few variegated brooms in the plant world, and this is the first variegated broom on a maple that we know of. This new selection was found as a broom on ‘Beni shichihenge’ and selected by our good friend, Carl Munn. We had the honor and privilege to be able to get this tree first, evaluate it and name this tree ‘Pink Princess’. ‘Pink Princess’ leafs out in the spring with pink margined variegation on a green leaf. During the summer, the pink fades to white. ‘Pink Princess’ appears to be a vigorous dwarf globe reaching 4 ft in height by 4 ft in width in 10 years. Give it protection from the hot afternoon sun to keep the pink spring color longer into the season. Fall color on ‘Pink Princess’ is orange to red. These trees are for local pickup only, we cannot ship them because they are too big. The MrMaple Nursery is located in East Flat Rock, NC. Please contact us to arrange a pickup time.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum ‘Pink Princess'，矮生粉叶日本枫，适生区 5-9。 ‘Pink Princess’ 是一个新的矮生紧凑型日本枫选育品种，具斑叶特征。 植物界中带斑锦的丛生芽变极为少见，而据我们所知，这是枫树上首个带斑锦的丛生芽变品种。 这个新品种是在 ‘Beni shichihenge’ 上发现的丛生芽变，由我们的好友 Carl Munn 选出。 我们有幸最先获得此树，对其进行评估，并将其命名为 ‘Pink Princess’。 ‘Pink Princess’ 春季展叶时为绿色叶片配粉色镶边斑锦，夏季粉色会逐渐褪为白色。 该品种似乎是生长势较强的矮生球形品种，10 年可达高 4 英尺、宽 4 英尺。 建议避开炎热的午后强光，以让春季的粉色维持更久。 秋季叶色为橙至红色。 这些植株仅限到园自提，因体量过大无法邮寄。 MrMaple Nursery 位于北卡罗来纳州 East Flat Rock，请联系我们安排提货时间。
